blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The US-led Pax Silica initiative is meant to serve as a backup source of advanced chips in the event of an invasion of Taiwan, Palawan Rep. Jose Alvarez said Thursday. His remarks came amid the Philippines’ involvement in the US-led chips and critical minerals initiative and Washington’s deepening tech rivalry with Beijing. “If China were to overrun Taiwan, at least they would have a replacement source to draw from,” Alvarez, who sponsored the Department of Environment and Natural Resources’ proposed budget for next year, told lawmakers in Filipino. “Pax Silica is just advanced planning in case Taiwan … […]...
